description: This file contains functions for collecting system statistics on Linux, such as uptime, load average, memory usage, and CPU usage, by reading from /proc files and system calls.

methods.name: getUptime
methods.description: Reads system uptime from a specified proc file and returns an UptimeSample with the current time and uptime value.

methods.name: getLoadAvgSample
methods.description: Reads load average data from a specified proc file and returns a LoadAvgSample with current time and load averages for 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

methods.name: getMemSample
methods.description: Reads memory information from a specified proc file and returns a MemSample with memory and swap details, including buffers, cached, total, free, used, and used swap.

methods.name: getProcCPUSample
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage for the current process using syscall.Getrusage and returns a ProcCPUSample with user, system, total CPU time, and memory used.

methods.name: getCPUSample
methods.description: Reads CPU statistics from /proc/stat and returns a CPUSample with CPU times.
